short: Below the seam: runtime, port, programs, forms
is: Everything below the seam: one ManagedRuntime, one `ZurfurApi` port, outcome-returning programs per domain, one Schema module per form.
conventions: Programs return an OUTCOME UNION (data or a renderable Problem), not a raw Effect — loads/actions `runApi(program)` and branch.
Ports by role with a prod Layer and an in-memory test Layer (`zurfurApiTest`) — adapter-mem parity; specs never touch the network.
Validation is server-side; browser `required` is a courtesy.
Auth-time accepts what claim-time rejects: punycode handles pass `handleField` at sign-in, fail `claimHandleField` at account creation.

fs.name: *.spec.ts
fs.role: node-project specs beside each program module (accounts, session, den, api-proxy, session-headers, session-gate, frame-headers, handle-chain, error-log, time-limits, request-deadline, unanswered, bounded-fetch); time-limits-gc.spec.ts runs the limits and the deadline through kit's real event.fetch, handleFetch and undici to a local backend that never answers (or stalls its body), forcing garbage collection while each call waits: each still fails on time and its connection closes; den/den-path.spec.ts holds the path-handling security cases; den-golden.spec.ts serves every Den golden response (contract/golden/den/, one test per file, index and disk kept equal) through the live port and the den program

fs.name: accounts.ts
fs.role: account programs (accountsOutcome, accountOutcome, create/deleteAccountOutcome); the delete's API path goes through path-builder.ts; a create or delete that isn't answered becomes a 503 problem saying it may have gone through

fs.name: api-proxy.ts
fs.role: pure rewriteApiRequest + extractSessionCookie + carriesSessionCookie, used by hooks.server.ts and session-headers.ts (no $env, unit-tests standalone); the request leaving the server carries the signal it is given directly, never one followed through the rebuilt requests in between; forwards a sole zurfur.sid only, none when the header carries two or more pairs, and never the sign-in browser-binding cookie (it reaches axum only on /signin-callback, through Caddy)

fs.name: api/
fs.role: the backend port + tagged error union + generated protobuf messages

fs.name: bounded-fetch.ts
fs.role: the pieces of a bounded backend call: settleBy (a call fails by its signal's abort on its own timer, whether or not the abort reaches the fetch), firstAbortOf (a combined signal held by listeners, not AbortSignal.any), readWhole (the body read into memory), whileHeld (the Requests of a call held until it ends: undici's Request follows another signal through a WeakRef to its own controller, so a collected Request stops passing the abort on)

fs.name: cookies.ts
fs.role: every cookie name Zurfur sets (closed SessionCookieName | SignInBindingCookieName) and cookieOptions, the one set/clear options helper; the backend ZurfurCookie's twin

fs.name: den.ts
fs.role: the den page's program: read the node at an address through the port (and, on a full page load, its ancestors' listings), at most 4 Den reads in flight per page load with the node read first, name each Account node the page shows by the Account's own name (den/account-names.ts, after every read), map the read to the web's Den view with every link built by the path builder; outcomes: page / reload (stale token) / signedOut

fs.name: den/
fs.role: den-path.ts — the Den path builder: browser pathname → segments (decoded once, allowlisted, ≤16), allowlisted query (includeDeleted, pageToken), the only DenHref mint, the API path; account-names.ts — an Account node (type account, keyed by its DID) named from the viewer's GET /accounts list, read once per page that shows one, none otherwise; an unlisted DID or a failed list keeps the Den's name

fs.name: error-log.ts
fs.role: pure logUnexpectedError (hooks.server.ts's handleError): logs route template + status only, returns a fixed message

fs.name: forms/
fs.role: one Effect Schema per form (login, create-account, delete-account) over a shared handle field; problem-message.ts bridges a Problem onto the superform message

fs.name: frame-headers.ts
fs.role: refuseFraming handle hook: Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none' and X-Frame-Options: DENY on every response

fs.name: handle-chain.ts
fs.role: handleChain(...handles): the handle hooks as one, first outermost — a plain stand-in for SvelteKit's sequence, which needs the live request store and can't be unit-tested

fs.name: path-builder.ts
fs.role: the one way a path is put together from pieces: each piece a minted PathSegment, `%` escaped, then parsed back to prove the URL parser reads exactly what was built; used by the Den path builder and the account-delete call

fs.name: request-deadline.ts
fs.role: requestDeadline, the first handle hook: one 15 s deadline per request, handed to handleFetch through locals and stopped once the response is ready

fs.name: runtime.ts
fs.role: THE SEAM — process-wide ManagedRuntime; runApi is the only Effect→Promise crossing

fs.name: session-gate.ts
fs.role: the sign-in gate, the one real one: a handle hook that, for every (session) route (page, __data.json whatever it skips, form action), asks the backend who is signed in and redirects to /login if nobody is (a 401), or answers with its own "isn't answering" page (unanswered.ts) when the backend can't be reached or runs out of time — returned, so the outer hooks stamp it — before any load or action runs; hands the session to the root layout through locals. The sign-out action is let through, so it can always clear the browser's session

fs.name: session-headers.ts
fs.role: pure sessionHeaders handle hook used by hooks.server.ts: marks every response to a request carrying any session cookie pair (two included) Cache-Control: private, no-store and Referrer-Policy: same-origin

fs.name: session.ts
fs.role: session programs (sessionCheck — the gate's signedIn / signedOut / unanswered —, sessionOrAnonymous, optionalSession, signinOutcome — the PDS URL plus the browser-binding cookie to relay, or a problem to render, a start that isn't answered included —, signoutOutcome)

fs.name: time-limits.ts
fs.role: TIME_LIMITS — how long the web waits for the API: the session check 5 s, any other call 10 s, sign-out 5 s, the whole request 15 s — and countdown, a stoppable timer whose signal aborts with a TimeoutError (fake timers drive it in specs)

fs.name: unanswered.ts
fs.role: what the web does when Zurfur doesn't answer: UNANSWERED_PAGE, the sign-in gate's fixed HTML (503, "Zurfur isn't answering right now.", a "Try again" href="" that writes nothing from the request, no script — the one HTML written outside Svelte); unansweredResponse (an enhanced form post gets a 503 error action result instead; both carry Cache-Control: no-store and Referrer-Policy: same-origin themselves, session cookie or not); runRead, runApi for a page's own reads, failing a NetworkFailure to error(503)
